propositions: Production bypasses of canonical store write seams occurred via raw git subprocess calls in Python modules and GitHub workflows, particularly in reconcile-bridge.yml using bare git add/commit without tracker context

A deterministic two-layer CI lint must flag raw git mutations (add/commit/rm/reset/update-ref/checkout/clean) in Python code and workflows, with exception only for inline markers carrying mandatory reasons

The lint must distinguish legitimate seam internals (gitutil, event_append, txn, reconciler git_adapter) and disposable sandbox repos from unauthorized bypasses using local intra-function argv tracking and cwd-aware workflow parsing
Marker-without-reason and opaque argv expressions must fail fail-closed; the authoritative remediation inventory comes from report-mode bootstrap, not static enumeration
The store write seams are exactly two: locked transaction/append APIs and reconciler git_adapter; teaching messages must direct authors to these sanctioned APIs, not raw run_git_write calls
